import pandas
import io

schedule = pandas.DataFrame( _('HTTP Request').first().json.games )
schedule['starts_at'] = pandas.to_datetime(schedule['scheduled'])
schedule['starts_at'] = schedule['starts_at'].dt.tz_convert('America/New_York')
csv_string = io.StringIO( _('name-to-icon-map').first().json['name-to-icon-map.csv'] )
abbreviations = pandas.read_csv( csv_string ).set_index('abbreviation')

home = list(schedule['home'])
away = list(schedule['away'])
abbreviation = lambda x: {'abbreviation': x['alias'], 'name': x['name'], 'icon':abbreviations.loc[x['alias']].icon}
home = [ abbreviation( x ) for x in home ]
away = [ abbreviation( x ) for x in away ]

schedule['home'] = home
schedule['away'] = away

schedule['starts_at'] = schedule['starts_at'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
schedule['date'] = schedule['starts_at'].str.split(' ').str[0]

return schedule.to_dict( orient='records' )
